def Saisie():
    b = False
    while not b:
        ph = str(input("Donner unephrase: "))
        b = verif(ph)
    return ph


def verif(ch):
    i = -1
    ok = ch[len(ch) - 1] == "."
    while ok and i < len(ch) - 2:
        i += 1
        ok = "A" <= ch[i] <= "Z" or ch[i] == " "
    return ok


def saisie_entier():
    b = False
    while not b:
        n = int(input("< "))
        b = 2 <= n <= 10
    return n


def cryptage(ph, p, q):
    R = ""
    for i in range(len(ph) - 1):
        if ph[i] != " ":  #and ph[i] != ".":

            R = R + chr((p * (ord(ph[i]) - 64) + q) % 26 + 1 + 64)
        else:
            R += ph[i]
    print(R)

ph = Saisie()
print("______saisie de p______")
p = saisie_entier()
print("______saisie de q______")
q = saisie_entier()
cryptage(ph, p, q)
